questions.subject: PYTHON
questions.learningObjective: Identify which exception a handler catches
questions.stem: A field biologist's survey script raises ValueError when a transect length is negative; which exception type does the except ValueError block intercept?

options.text: It intercepts only the exact ValueError class
It intercepts only ValueError and its subclasses
It intercepts every exception raised anywhere in the program
options.misconception: confuses a typed handler with a bare handler

questions.explanation: A named handler matches the stated type and its subclasses, but here the correct reading is the typed handler for ValueError. The tempting idea that it catches everything confuses it with a bare except.
